mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the federal funds rate over the preceding three months signals a tightening monetary regime, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate cash flows, thereby depressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises by >0.25% per month for 3 consecutive months as of decision time
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) during periods when this trigger is met.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) exceeding 2% coincident with a softening labor market (UNRATE < 6%) signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY change < -2% AND UNRATE < 6.0% at decision time
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) during triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) of at least 100,000 for three consecutive months signals robust labor market expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and supports higher equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by >100,000 for 3 consecutive months as of decision time
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.10) during triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: A two-month acceleration in industrial production growth (INDPRO) above 0.5% per month, accompanied by rising housing starts (HOUST), signals improving supply capacity and economic momentum, which lifts investor sentiment and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO 2-month Δ > 0.5% AND HOUST > previous month
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.10) during triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A low and stable federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.5% for at least six months) in conjunction with rising consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%) signals accommodative monetary policy amid inflationary pressure, which historically correlates with elevated equity risk premia and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.5% for 6 months AND CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% at decision time
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.10) during triggered regimes.

mechanism_narrative: A sequential decline in real retail sales (RSAFS) over two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, regardless of regime.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) during periods of two consecutive monthly declines in RSAFS.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.4 percentage points month-over-month, coupled with a simultaneous deceleration in industrial production (INDPRO) of more than 0.3% month-over-month, signals a synchronized labor-supply and output shock that increases recession risk and depresses S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE Δ > +0.4pp AND INDPRO Δ < -0.3% in the same month as decision time
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) during triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 0.8% for four consecutive months signals a robust supply-side expansion, which boosts earnings visibility and supports higher equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO > 0.8% for 4 consecutive months as of decision time
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.10) during triggered periods.
